parsed.rationale: Both `PlaybackController` (line 27) and `AudioPlayerProtocol` (line 19) live in the same package (`Playback`) and the same directory (`Shared/Playback/Sources/PlaybackCore/Protocols/`), and they share five structurally identical members: `installRenderTap:()`, `isPlaying:Bool`, `makeAudioBufferStream:() -> AsyncStream<AVAudioPCMBuffer>`, `removeRenderTap:()`, and a `state` property (typed differently — `PlaybackState` vs `PlayerState` — which itself suggests a further unification opportunity). Extracting these shared members into a new parent protocol `AudioPlaybackCore` eliminates the duplication while preserving the divergent members (`play:(reason:)` / `stop:(reason:)` / `toggle:` / `isLoading` on `PlaybackController`, and `eventStream`, `stateStream`, `play:()` / `stop:()` on `AudioPlayerProtocol`). Neither record carries any restraint flag (`is_test`, `is_mock`, `is_sample_app`, `is_codegen` are all false), so the refactor is safe to pursue.
